subject: general
question: Which Middle Eastern country plays a central role in the IMEC alliance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saudi Arabia**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• The **India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC)** was officially launched during the **G20 Summit** in **New Delhi** in **September 2023**.

• **Saudi Arabia** plays a central role in the alliance as a key geographic and economic link between the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)** and the **Mediterranean** region.

• The corridor is designed to enhance **economic integration** and facilitate the transit of goods and services between **Asia**, the **Arabian Gulf**, and **Europe** through a combination of **maritime** and **railway** routes.

• The project involves a **railway line** that will traverse through **Saudi Arabia** and **Jordan**, connecting the **UAE** to the **Port of Haifa** in **Israel**.

• While **Qatar**, **Iran**, and **Oman** are significant Middle Eastern nations, they are not part of the primary **IMEC** memorandum of understanding signed by the founding members.

**Additional Information__**

• The **IMEC** is seen as a strategic alternative to China's **Belt and Road Initiative (BRI)**, focusing on transparency and high-quality infrastructure.

• The corridor consists of two distinct segments: the **East Corridor** (connecting India to the Arabian Gulf) and the **Northern Corridor** (connecting the Arabian Gulf to Europe).

• Signatories of the **IMEC** include **India**, the **United States**, **Saudi Arabia**, the **United Arab Emirates**, the **European Union**, **France**, **Germany**, and **Italy**.

• Beyond transport, the initiative aims to develop infrastructure for **clean hydrogen** exports and **undersea telecommunication cables** to boost digital connectivity.
